name: Dimitrios Papadopoulos
bio:
Dimitrios has been working with composites since his early twenties, initially in shipbuilding before making the jump to motorsport. He was drawn to the precision and high stakes of racing, finding that the pressure brought out the best in his work. Dimitrios is known for his meticulous approach, ensuring every piece meets the highest standards of quality and performance. 

His experience spans across various racing series, from rally to touring cars, giving him a broad understanding of the stresses and strains placed on composite components. He prides himself on his ability to adapt to new challenges and learn quickly, always seeking out innovative solutions to improve vehicle performance and safety. Dimitrios is a valuable asset to any team looking for a dependable and skilled composite technician.

physical.description: A stocky man with a weathered face and kind eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with technical sketches and calculations.
Insists on using a specific type of resin for all composite repairs, claiming it provides superior bonding.
Has a habit of humming quietly while working, often Greek folk songs.
